description: Survey of Motor Vehicle Use, Australia is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). Estimates of kilometres travelled, tonne-kilometres travelled, tonnes carried and fuel use for the 12 months ended 30 June 2020. Includes sub-annual estimates. Coverage is Australia, 2019 to 2020; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-01. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
